fields.v: No (0): both guided conditions evaluated (probe_refined and the static_kb it starts from) were created by the authors; the only other condition is the bare no_context prompt, which is not an external approach
fields.quote: no_context measures the agent alone, static_kb adds generic guidance, and probe_refined adds iterative refinement on top.
fields.why: The rule gives Partly when the authors' approach is compared with external ones; here no external approach is evaluated, only the authors' two artefacts and an empty-guidance baseline.
fields.doubt: Os dois tipos de orientação avaliados (static_kb e probe_refined) são dos autores; o no_context é só o prompt sem orientação, não uma abordagem externa. Pela regra, Partly só quando há abordagens externas. Lê a §3.2 (pág. 4) e decide entre Partly e No.
